plain: A cheap way to fine-tune a model by training a small add-on instead of changing all its weights.
eli5: Clipping a small new part onto a toy instead of rebuilding the whole toy.
technical: Low-rank adaptation (Hu et al. 2021): freeze the pretrained weights and learn a low-rank update BA added to selected weight matrices, which makes fine-tuning cheap enough for small targeted changes such as the Pain Axis paper's denial-removal adapter.
formula: W' = W + BA, with rank(BA) << dim(W)
